title.narrative: IR 1.1 IMMUNISATION

description.narrative: Intermediate Results (IR) 1.1: By 2018, maternal and neo-natal tetanos and polio are eradicated, under-five-y-o children mortality rate due to measles is reduced by 95%, and vaccination coverage for routine antigens is improved and maintained above 90% and the proportion of non or insufficiently- immunized children is reduced from 23% to 5%.
